primary_formula_source.title: Household Finance and Consumption Survey: Methodological report for the 2021 wave
primary_formula_source.publisher: European Central Bank, Statistics Paper Series No.45
primary_formula_source.section: 7.2, printed pages52–53 (PDF pages56–57), especially weight equation and7.2.1
primary_formula_source.verified_content: Single-stage strata sampled without replacement; w*=w(1-lambda+lambda*n/m*r), lambda=sqrt(m*(1-f)/(n-1)); m=n-1. This directly yields the implemented finite-correction weights.

original_method.title: Resampling Inference with Complex Survey Data

original_method.verification: Publisher abstract confirms stratified SRSWOR and standard variance recovery in the linear case; full paper not retrieved. Do not attribute an AP percentile coverage theorem.
